tags: @guarantee ok.nested-defaults "defu({ a: { b: 2 } }, { a: { b: 1, c: 3 } })" gives "{ a: { b: 2, c: 3 } }".
@guarantee ok.leftmost-priority The leftmost arguments have more priority when assigning defaults.

@guarantee ok.array-concat "defu({ array: ["b", "c"] }, { array: ["a"] })" gives "{ array: ["b", "c", "a"] }", so array values are concatenated with the object's items first when the default property is defined.
@guarantee ok.no-mutation The `object` and the `defaults` arguments are not modified.
@guarantee ok.skip-nullish Nullish values (`null` and `undefined`) are skipped.
@guarantee ok.skip-proto-keys Assignment of the "__proto__" and "constructor" keys is skipped to prevent object pollution.
@guarantee ok.custom-merger The `merger` function accepts `obj` (the source object), `key` and `value` (the current value) and returns `true` when it applied a custom merge.
@guarantee ok.sum-example A function created with `createDefu` whose merger adds numbers gives 25 for "cost" in `ext({ cost: 15 }, { cost: 10 })`.
@guarantee ok.function-called-with-default If the user provides a function for a key, it is called with the default value instead of being merged.

@guarantee ok.fn-example "defuFn" with `ignore` as a filter dropping "dist" and `count` as `count + 20`, over defaults `ignore` ["node_modules", "dist"] and `count` 10, gives `ignore` ["node_modules"] and `count` 30.
@guarantee ok.fn-undefined-default If the default value is not defined, the function is not called and is kept as the value.
@guarantee ok.array-only A function is called only when the value defined in the defaults is an array.
@guarantee ok.array-fn-example "defuArrayFn" with `ignore` as a filter dropping "dist" over the default ["node_modules", "dist"] gives `ignore` ["node_modules"].
@guarantee ok.non-array-kept With `count` as a function and the default `count` 10 (not an array), the function is not called and is kept as the value.
